name: hassan-ii-mosque
description: Long green-tiled hall roofs, closed central sliding roof, cream travertine arcades, square minaret on independent diagonal alignment with green mosaic fields and raised diamond tracery.
attribution: Survey plans © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Protomaps, ODbL 1.0. Architectural geometry originally authored for Vearth.

audit.dimension_uncertainty: Foundation dimensions give 190.5m structural tower above prayer floor; another foundation page rounds minaret to200m and describes a15.5m jamour. Model separates190.5m structure,4m roof and15.5m finial for210m silhouette; this height convention is not a survey reconciliation. Principal floor and roof absolute elevations use the Foundation's published NGM datum; the engine coastal vertical reference is treated as compatible at its terrain resolution. Basement envelopes follow measured footprints; depth to0.5m belowsea is a support allowance, not a surveyed excavation level.
audit.orientation: Source footprints in east/north metric coordinates; all component rotations baked into vertices.
audit.grounding: Hassan II floor uses published 9.50m NGM with authored sea-level basement supports; Shah/Qaboos use clean approach calibration in mosque-floor-calibrations.json. Bounded cuts stay beneath authored masonry/paving.
audit.approach_grounding: Independent bounded apron grades repair source terrain discontinuities while retaining fixed architectural floors; measured context, inferred transition extents and controls are recorded in setting-ground-calibrations.json.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
